items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I think that they're friends of mine... I liked him so much because Ash... I admired him so much.

ctx.x: What was the circumstances of his

I never knew. I think -- well, yes, I did too. It was his drinking. It wasn't his playing at all, it was his drinking. Irvin got -- he had a few personal problems, I think they were marital and other things, you know, and he started drinking quite a bit. So Nat didn't fire me, he
just starting cutting the salary. So finally he had to quit.
